title: Under Its Own Skin

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The river keeps its own note under its own skin, and the slate comes up the road on the twentieth whether the house has counted its days or not. Neither asks a house for leave.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Clay Yard

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and eleven to four hundred and thirteen days, six months and two hundred and thirty-one to two hundred and thirty-three days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 410 exact at the opening on answer 396, closing at 413 exact on answer 402. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting, and the yard well a stone lip and a bucket-round from the basket's low angle. Corin opens in the small hours of Ilmen 17 with the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 396 and the count exact at 410, the soft-cuffed clerk's entered figure kept on its own place with a finger between it and Tarn's degree and another between it and the face at the yard's edge, the fifth shaping of the well-saying found where put on its own tray, the first arithmetic of Y.H. 814 gone up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box with no key under any roof, and Ilmen 20's second reading one morning off and named only as a date if named. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it holding the fold found where put and still a finding, not a placing, the thread of drool stiff in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict (the crust lifted, the thread wiped, a hand on the pot handle), both true, the second louder, neither winning. The chapter's one meaningful change is held and unspoken: on Ilmen 18 Tarn's hand goes over blade and sill and away, and the sentence *Six counted. The next I don't count* is not said to the wood at all, and the boy files the silence on a place of its own — not a tenth stopping, not a payment, not a rule, not joined to the clerk's entered figure, the degree, the face or Jorra's promise, and not made a habit on the nineteenth. A second change, of weather, comes on Ilmen 19: a day of air less cold thins the sour tang at the Vail corner and the river's skin softens at one edge, and the yard calls it weather and Sella tells the fire it is the thaw, the boy filing it as a change held on a place of its own, not a sign, not a fourth covering, not a sixth shaping, not a payer and not made again.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Seventeenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{411}{Ilmen 17, Y.H. 814, Seventhday}: the small hours opening on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 396 and the count exact at 410, then first light and the morning's work; answer 397 filed, count 411 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-one days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects only. Walk-ons only at an ordinary Seventhday's grammar (pail on its stone, a loaf pushed a finger's width and stopped, barley wall to wall, a rake raised at the ridge and set down). No Berr on stage, no Hessa sighting, no man from Slate Row, no collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket and no figure given for the boy. New day, new date, no recap: the hand on the fold is the present moment, not a retelling, and nothing from Ilmen 14–16 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — crust two inches off with its corner hair-lifted and gone leathery, fold found where put and still a finding, thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint, the Afterdrop waiting — while the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict (T060/T086). He keeps four hundred and eleven exact against a house that keeps its days badly in loaves, glances and an unnamed space at the row's end, and does not stand the number up as a threshold or figure (T071/T072). The clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree and the face at the yard's edge stay on three places with a finger between every pair and are not joined or made a rule; Hessa's eighth hand, Ilva's ninth strip and Berr's box stay where put, unread and with no key (T080/T090, T015/T041/T047 held). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with a broken pot's back, keeps the charcoal unread and the grain covered and unfigured, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, carries him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a second fold, and leaves the widow's mark untouched because no morning is an opening (T058/T079/T100, T077, T009/T013/T092). Six honest answers begin on the sixth place, not one a doctrine.

scenes.title: What the Seventeenth Day Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 17 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 398 and the count at 411 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar (pail set down where a pail always stands, rope settling into its knot, loaf stopped short of a figure, barley passed wall to wall without a number). No man from Slate Row, no clerk sighting, no fifth shaping made or repeated, no sixth of anything, no second telling at the well and no ownerless voice over the boards; no slate opened within reach of the basket. Day already dated in Scene 1. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather, goes around the seven walked-around places once and not twice with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back, and keeps the wide step as a keeping and not a sign (T098, T009/T013/T092). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry: a figure rises out of a shut fist toward the well, looks at the light and goes back into a sleeve; a woman sent to ask what a pot cost is sent to the pot and gets a note and not a price; the dressed grain lies covered and the arithmetic read on Ilmen 10 did not know what it cost, with no signature on the space between (T077). The clerk's entered figure, the degree and the face are not laid across one another and no witness, reader or payer stands under any of them (T080/T090, T036/T076). Sella at the going of the light keeps the whole hearth grammar and leaves the crack showing; repair stays apart from restoration (T058/T079/T100). In the small hours the towel comes out and the boy goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside, the heard bell in its square beside the told, three counts in three places staying three, the kept fire's four pulls and missing fifth with its payer unnamed, four rooms with the same gap held apart, nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth (T061/T082, T078, T088, T081, T080). The carpet of small keepings gathers interest toward the far-off hand that is not his; exact last image: the hand outside the wool goes up the inch toward the river's note, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ends, and comes straight down and lies flat against the fold on answer 398.

scenes.title: The Eighteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{412}{Ilmen 18, Y.H. 814, Eighthday}: the small hours opening the day, then first light and the morning's work, with answer 399 and the count at 412 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-two days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the ordinary morning grammar. Ilva offstage with her strip in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine; Hessa not a sighting and her eighth hand unread up the road; the man from Slate Row's face, the clerk's entered figure, the fifth shaping and the first arithmetic gone up the road stay on their own places where put. No Berr, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand or eleventh arithmetic; no slate opened within reach of the basket. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from the seventeenth crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and Ilmen 20 is named only as a date if named and is not brought into a day that has not earned it. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — the crust leathery past the point where a child would still eat it, the fold found where put, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping as at the end of a written line, the Afterdrop waiting — and knows a basket set level out of the draught where heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; the infant's three wants quarrel, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). He keeps four hundred and twelve exact and does not stand the number up as a threshold (T071/T072). Sella keeps the whole hearth grammar at the hearth before the basket, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, gives both proverbs to the pot and the fire and never to a person, keeps her hand above the unread charcoal, glances once at the cold clay jar with the hand half over nothing, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and does not touch the widow's mark at a shelf, a well or a morning (T058/T079/T100, T077). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust ground past the bent finger, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from any High Kiln master, and takes his finger from the cold damper without the extra holding of Ash 26 (T062/T035/T031). In the small hours answer 399 is filed, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air.

scenes.title: The Sentence Not Said
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 18 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 400 and the count at 412 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar. THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, advanced and NOT paid: at the kindling in the afternoon Tarn keeps six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, his hand goes over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach — and the sentence *Six counted. The next I don't count* is not said to the wood at all. He says nothing to the wood, takes the broom only after the flagstones have had their instruction, says *Yes, house* to the question and to the thing behind it, and goes over the stones without a word and without a turn of the head toward the landing. The boy files the silence on a place of its own: not a tenth stopping, not a payment, not a hearing, not a rule, not joined to the clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree, the face at the yard's edge or Jorra's ungiven promise, and expressly not repeated as a habit on the nineteenth. The sixth piece is still six, the seventh still at the lip, the Seed 16 breath still unspent, the loan still uncalled at the very end of a term already ended, the warm loft stone still unreconciled by not trying (T036/T076/T006 advanced, not paid). Dramatic purpose: the checking is the work, not the sentence; the boy reads the withheld sentence as a hand withdrawn from a field before the dressing goes on, exact, complete and worth nothing, and refuses to let the silence stand up beside the three held nothings and call itself a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T061/T082). Sella at the going of the light keeps the whole hearth grammar with the grain unfigured, the charcoal unread and the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand; repair stays apart from restoration and the crack shows (T058/T079/T100, T077). In the small hours the towel comes out and the boy goes over the field by the place of each thing, leaving every gap a gap: the clerk's entered figure on its place with a finger between it and the degree and another between it and the face, the fifth shaping on its own tray, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken four hundred and twelve days, the full note at six with the seventh empty (T090/T080, T088, T061/T082). Exact last image: the hand laid itself flat against the fold on answer 400 as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking.

scenes.title: The Nineteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{413}{Ilmen 19, Y.H. 814, Ninthday}: the small hours opening the day, then first light and the morning's work, with answer 401 and the count at 413 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-three days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the ordinary Ninthday grammar; Tarn tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* again, so the eighteenth's silence is a change found where put and not made a habit (T036/T076 held). Ilva's strip stays in her sleeve unread and Hessa's slate stays up the road unread, their hands ninth and eighth with no tenth; Berr's box stays locked up the clay road and no key comes under any roof; the clerk stays set below the north bridge with the entered figure on its own place; the man from Slate Row's face is not on stage. No Berr, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell, no sixth shaping, no eighth green or shape and no ownerless voice; no slate opened within reach of the basket. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from the eighteenth crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and Ilmen 20 (Day 414) stands one morning beyond the close, unbrought. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order and reads the crust gone harder through another dry night, the fold found where put, the thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at the small bare wrist-joint and the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform, while the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). He keeps four hundred and thirteen exact against a house that keeps its days badly in loaves and glances, and does not stand the number up as a threshold, a doctrine or a figure, and does not lay the twelve old arithmetics across the first of the new count to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer (T071/T072, T015/T041/T047 held). Sella keeps the hearth grammar at both ends of the day, gives the instruction to the wool, the river wind, the pot, the fire and the banked fire and never to the basket, carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, goes wide around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, widest at the returning-line place, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, and adds no second fold (T058/T079, T098, T009/T013/T092). The five askings of the row stand at five with no witness and no sixth; the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the four Ash and Slate directions and the holding at the fold stand where put and do not repeat (T065/T095, T097). In the small hours answer 401 is filed, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air.

scenes.title: A Hair Under the Skin
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Ilmen 19 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 402 and the count at 413 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Offstage with keepings found where put: Tarn at kindling and flagstones with the eighteenth's silence held, Jorra at the wheel-shed and cold damper, Ilva with her strip in her sleeve, the clerk's entered figure on its own place beside Tarn's degree and the face at the yard's edge, Hessa's eighth hand on its tray, the fifth shaping of the well-saying on its own tray, Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the first arithmetic inside, the green at the pot board and the shape at the market's edge as sightings with no eighth, and the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate reported at the out-of-line landing. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar. No second telling at the well, no market, no collector, no present-tense break and no \memory{} tag; no sixth hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, sixth shaping, thirteenth arithmetic, signature, payer, witness or reader. Day already dated in Scene 5. A SECOND CHANGE, of weather, advanced and NOT paid: in the afternoon a day of air less cold comes off the river and thins the sour tang at the Vail corner, and the river's skin softens at one edge where the low note runs nearer under it; the yard calls it weather, Sella tells the fire it is the thaw, and the boy files the change on a place of its own beside the clean dark line, the new finer grey, the called-gone grey and the river under its skin — not a sign, not a fourth covering, not a sixth shaping, not a hearing, not a payment, no hand or payer under it and not made again (T083/T085/T092, T009/T013/T092 advanced, not paid). Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather, goes around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, keeps the called-gone grey beside the left-in-place ridge with a finger between, and makes no likeness a cause (T098, T083/T085). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry; the covered grain's arithmetic did not know what it cost and no signature stands on the space (T077). Sella at the going of the light keeps the whole hearth grammar, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, righted the fold without a look at his face, leaves the crack showing and leaves the widow's mark untouched (T058/T079/T100, T077). In the small hours the towel comes out and the boy goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap: the clerk's entered figure, the degree and the face held apart, the fifth shaping on its own tray, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty, the Drawing's knock outside, four rooms with the same gap held apart, the heard bell in its square beside the told with both gaps in their own squares, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, Tarn's unspoken sentence on its own place, Ilmen 20's second reading waiting one morning off as a date and not brought (T061/T082, T078, T081, T080, T036/T076, T015/T041/T047). Answer 402 is filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer; six honest answers stand on the sixth place, 397 through 402, and not one is a doctrine. Count 413 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-three days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two counts standing side by side without becoming one. Exact last image: the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, the inch not a reach, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, neither early nor stayed, lets it go as the note ends, and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking; the crust's corner stands a hair off the wool, the thread is frozen and unwiped, four low pulls breathe below the floor with the fifth unsupplied, the first arithmetic of the year is up the road in a locked box with no key in his hand, and the house goes on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept — forward, into a morning not yet earned and not brought into this one.
